ei.title: From Boredom to Wonder in the Night Sky
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Noah sat on the park bench, watching people set up telescopes. His parents had brought him to see a meteor shower, but he didn't care much. He had never thought the night sky was interesting. Stars were just tiny dots, and he didn't see why people were so excited. He folded his arms and stared at the ground, waiting for time to pass. Around him, voices buzzed with excitement, but he barely listened. Then, a sudden wave of surprise spread through the crowd. He looked up. A bright line of light shot across the sky, then another. The meteors burned fast, disappearing in seconds. His eyes widened. How often did this happen? Could he predict the next one? Were there more coming? He leaned forward, scanning every corner of the sky. The stars, once meaningless, now held his full attention. For the first time, he truly wanted to see more.

det.analysis: Noah가 유성을 본 후 세 가지 궁금증 중 하나. '더 많이(more) 올지(coming)' 궁금해하는 문장은 Were there more coming? 유일. 4단어로 구성.
det.tip: more coming = 더 많이 오다. 세 질문 중 '추가 유성'에 대한 궁금증

questions.passage: Noah sat on the park bench, watching people set up telescopes. His parents had brought him to see a meteor shower, but he didn't care much. He had never thought the night sky was interesting. Stars were just tiny dots, and he didn't see why people were so excited. He folded his arms and stared at the ground, waiting for time to pass. Around him, voices buzzed with excitement, but he barely listened. Then, a sudden wave of surprise spread through the crowd. He looked up. A bright line of light shot across the sky, then another. The meteors burned fast, disappearing in seconds. His eyes widened. How often did this happen? Could he predict the next one? Were there more coming? He leaned forward, scanning every corner of the sky. __________. For the first time, he truly wanted to see more.
